title: Bechet's teaching method: melody then variations
summary: Bechet taught him to play the melody straight then vary it, using popular tunes like Intermezzo and Prisoner of Love, and valued contemporary expression and varied repertoire.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Becoming a teacher: jazz in schools and conservatories
